name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-aftereffects
description: MCP server for Adobe After Effects: drives a running After Effects through an ExtendScript bridge

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_DATA_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: This server's own files: the token the bridge presents, the announcements the bridge reads to find running servers, captured frames. Default: ~/.s3l-mcp-aftereffects.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_PROJECT_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: The project folder: captures and renders asked for without a path land in it. Default: the folder the client starts the server in.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_BRIDGE__PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the server listens on for the bridge inside After Effects; 0 takes a free one, which the announcement under the data directory names.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_BRIDGE__LISTEN
environmentVariables.description: The address the bridge listener binds; empty binds the loopback for a loopback host and every interface otherwise.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_BRIDGE__HOST
environmentVariables.description: The address the bridge inside After Effects dials to reach this server, written into the announcement; in a container the server's service name.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_BRIDGE__REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for one bridge reply; renders and imports use their own longer timeout.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_BRIDGE__TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret the bridge presents when it connects; empty reads the token file.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_BRIDGE__TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where that token lives. Default: <data>/state/token.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes without a tool call after which the process exits on its own; 0, the default, disables the watchdog, since a client that ends closes the pipe and the server exits with it.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_SKILL_IDLE_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes a loaded skill may go unused before its tools leave the catalog; 0 keeps skills loaded.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_FARM_PARALLEL
environmentVariables.description: How many aerender renders the farm runs at once; 1 renders jobs one after another.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Name this server signs its requests with, so the bridge's journal tells agents apart.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the settings file, with the same keys under a Snail section; when set, it is the only file read, and none is read if it does not exist.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_SCRIPTING
environmentVariables.description: allow (the default) offers ae_script, which runs any ExtendScript; off hides it, and refuses run_tools lists that carry a script step.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Stdio when the client starts this server over stdio (the default); Http to run it on its own beside After Effects and let clients connect with keys.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_HTTP__URL
environmentVariables.description: Where the HTTP server listens; a container listens on http://0.0.0.0:8080.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_HTTP__TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The token clients present as a bearer; the configured token holds every scope. Prefer keys minted with the clients command.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_HTTP__TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: A file holding the token, the way a container receives a secret.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_HTTP__PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: The address clients reach the server at behind a reverse proxy, which links to files are built on.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_HTTP__LINK_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes a signed link to a file stays valid.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_AFTEREFFECTS_HTTP__UPLOAD_PART_MB
environmentVariables.description: Megabytes an upload sends in one request, which a reverse proxy must read within its own body timeout.
